page_title: RAY 1-0 ELC | Rayo Vallecano v Elche 03/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
90+3' The substitution has been made. Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Jorge de Frutos.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Yago Santiago (Elche), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
89' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
84' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia makes way for Pacha (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Substitution. Alemao is replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yago Santiago (Elche) replacing Buba Sangare.
82' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
81' Rayo Vallecano keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
77' Substitution. Gonzalo Villar (Elche) replaces Aleix Febas.
77' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Marc Aguado and he is replaced by Federico Redondo Solari (Elche).
77' Andre Silva (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alvaro Rodriguez.
74' 1 - 0 Goal! Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Alvaro Garcia, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
72' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box.
71' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
70' Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' Rayo Vallecano quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
70' Half-chance! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) plays a pass into the box, but Matias Dituro reacts well to snuff out the attack.
68' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the right post.
66' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Isi Palazon is replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Oscar Valentin can be given a rest.
65' A snap shot by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Matias Dituro produces a good save to thwart him.
64' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Matias Dituro comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) has tested the patience of referee Jose Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
61' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matias Dituro intercepts the ball.
61' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
61' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Matias Dituro has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
58' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
51' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matias Dituro, who smothers the ball.
49' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
47' Now Elche have a corner.
46' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top left corner is far too weak and Augusto Batalla makes a simple save.
46' The substitution is prepared. Adria Pedrosa (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rafa Mir.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Jose Munuera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Rafa Mir (Elche) for his blatant foul.
42' The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Pedro Bigas (Elche) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
37' Elche are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
36' A pass by Buba Sangare (Elche) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
34' What a big chance! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.

33' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
31' A mistake by a defender gifts Rafa Mir (Elche) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
29' The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
29' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Matias Dituro was alert and made a comfortable save.
28' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
25' The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
25' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
23' Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' It's like he was asking for a caution. Pedro Bigas (Elche) receives a yellow card.
18' A snap shot by Rafa Mir (Elche) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Augusto Batalla produces a good save to thwart him.
16' Pedro Bigas (Elche) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
16' German Valera (Elche) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
16' Tete Morente (Elche) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
14' Elche win a corner.
13' Tete Morente (Elche) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
12' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Rafa Mir (Elche), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
9' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
8' It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
4' Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
4' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.

2' Rafa Mir (Elche) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed to the bottom left corner, but it lacks power and Augusto Batalla pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
2' Elche get a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Elche will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera will supervise the game today.
